explanation: All choices use the same ample-capacity GELU residual MLP, so optimizer progress is decisive. A uses plain SGD at 3e-4, which is nearly frozen over 256 steps. B makes meaningful adaptive progress, but Adam at 3e-4 reaches only about Δ≈0.077 and also has stronger weight decay. C uses momentum SGD at 3e-3; for MSE regression, momentum-0.9 SGD is calibrated as roughly Adam at one-third the learning rate, giving substantially more useful progress (around Δ≈0.25) without reaching the high-Δ overshoot regime. Thus C should achieve the lowest test MSE.
